title: Rank Math PRO WordPress Plugin Compromised in Supply Chain Attack
description: The Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin version 3.0.123 was compromised in a supply chain attack, with malware injected into packages distributed between October 15 and October 16, 2026. The malicious code could allow attackers to take over websites where the plugin was activated. The malware is persistent, recreating hidden backdoors and modifying files and settings to maintain access. Rank Math released a clean version 3.0.124 immediately after discovering the compromise. Users who installed or activated version 3.0.123 during the affected window should consider their sites compromised and restore from clean backups or follow detailed cleanup steps.
aiSummary: Hackers injected malware into Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin version 3.0.123 packages distributed between October 15, 2026, 20:02 UTC and October 16, 2026, 07:12 UTC. The malware enables persistent backdoors that can recreate themselves upon page visits, exposing credentials, API keys, and other secrets. It modifies .htaccess files, drops PHP code disguised as .cache files, schedules tasks and cron jobs, alters other plugins and themes, and may affect system-level files outside the WordPress installation. Rank Math promptly removed the malicious files and released version 3.0.124. Users who installed or activated the compromised version should restore from backups or follow extensive manual cleanup procedures including deleting plugin folders, removing malicious database entries, blocking attacker domains, and checking for suspicious system files and processes.
aiImpact: The malware provides attackers with persistent access to compromised websites, potentially exposing sensitive credentials, API keys, and secrets. It can maintain persistence by recreating backdoors on each page visit and modifying core WordPress files, plugins, themes, and system-level files. This could lead to full site takeover and unauthorized control over affected web servers.
